items.question: What courses are offered at VEL Pharmacy College?
items.answer: VEL Pharmacy College offers the 4-year Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm) undergraduate degree program across 8 semesters. The program is recognized and approved by the Pharmacy Council of India (PCI), New Delhi, and is affiliated to Vels Institute of Science, Technology & Advanced Studies (VISTAS).

items.question: What is the admission eligibility for B.Pharm at VEL Pharmacy College?
items.answer: As per Pharmacy Council of India (PCI) norms, candidates must have passed higher secondary (+2) examination with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics or Biology/Botany and Zoology. Admission is strictly merit-based on the percentage of marks secured in the qualifying examination.

items.question: Where is VEL Pharmacy College located?
items.answer: VEL Pharmacy College is located in the VMCH Campus, No.12/123, Periyapalayam Road, Velan Nagar, Manjankaranai Village, Uthukottai Taluk, Tiruvallur District – 601102, Tamil Nadu, India. The institution features a tranquil, pollution-free, green educational environment.

items.question: Is VEL Pharmacy College approved by the Pharmacy Council of India (PCI)?
items.answer: Yes, VEL Pharmacy College is recognized and approved by the Pharmacy Council of India (PCI), New Delhi. It is an off-campus center of VISTAS (Vels Institute of Science, Technology & Advanced Studies, Deemed to be University estd. u/s 3 of UGC Act, 1956).

items.question: What facilities are available for students at VEL Pharmacy College?
items.answer: The campus features spacious lecture halls with LCD projectors, advanced pharmaceutical laboratories, an air-conditioned 50-seater computer lab, a library with 1,500+ books and e-journals, on-campus Vels Medical College Hospital (VMCH) training, separate hostels for boys and girls, and transport services across the city.

welcome.paragraph_1: Pharmacy is the profession concerned with the art and science of preparing drugs from natural and synthetic sources and converting them into suitable and convenient materials for the treatment and prevention of disease.

legacy.subtitle: Heritage & Foundation
legacy.title: Our Institutional Journey
legacy.description: From a pioneering pharmacy college founded in 1992 to a Deemed University off-campus center of excellence.
legacy.card_heading: A Legacy Built on Educational Philanthropy & Academic Vision
legacy.p1: The great visionary, educationist, philanthropist, and sports enthusiast Dr. Ishari K. Ganesh, the dynamic Founder Chancellor of VISTAS Deemed University in India, established VEL Pharmacy College in the academic year 2024–25 in the Vels Medical College Campus at Manjankaranai.
legacy.p2: This institution represents an expansion of the School of Pharmaceutical Studies, which was originally established by the Vaels Educational Trust in the year 1992 as Vels College of Pharmacy. Over three decades, it introduced pioneering undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral (Pharm.D & Ph.D.) programs in pharmaceutical sciences.
legacy.p3: In 2008, the college achieved university recognition as a constituent institution of VELS INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE TECHNOLOGY AND ADVANCED STUDIES (VISTAS), Deemed to be University Estd. U/S 3 of the UGC Act, 1956. VEL Pharmacy College continues this rich heritage by delivering PCI-prescribed education in a tranquil, state-of-the-art campus.

leaders.name: Dr. Ishari K. Ganesh
leaders.title: Founder & Chancellor • Vels Group of Institutions & VISTAS Deemed to be University
leaders.quote:
Education is not merely the acquisition of theoretical qualifications, but the catalyst for nation-building, social transformation, and compassionate service to humanity.

Vels University has successfully advanced into its sixteenth year since it was declared a Deemed-to-be University in 2008. Rising from a modest start in 1992 under the inspiration of my illustrious father, late Shri Isari Velan (former Minister in Tamil Nadu Government), Vels Group of Institutions has now expanded over 11 excellent educational campuses with international standard facilities, qualified faculty, modern laboratories, and global exchange programs. Our steadfast commitment is to empower VEL Pharmacy College students with clinical mastery and ethical dedication to society.

leaders.name: Dr. Preethaa Ganesh
leaders.title: B.E.CSE, Master in Management, Ph.D. • Vice-President, Vels Group of Institutions
leaders.quote:
Modern healthcare and professional education demand progressive administrative vision, world-class infrastructure, and a student-centric learning environment.

Dr Preethaa manages operations of the Vels conglomerate comprising 43 institutions, 36,000 students and 6,000 staff across India, Singapore, and the United Kingdom. With her advanced Master's in Management from the London School of Economics and Political Sciences (LSE) and Ph.D. in Women Entrepreneurship, she guides institutional expansion, international academic partnerships, and student welfare initiatives across all group campuses.

leaders.name: Dr. A. Jothi Murugan
leaders.title: Pro-Chancellor (Planning & Development), VISTAS
leaders.quote:
Sustainable academic distinction requires visionary master planning, rigorous curriculum governance, and continuous benchmarking against premier global standards.

Entering into the teaching profession as a Tutor in Economics at Pachaiyappa’s College, Chennai in 1971, Dr. A. Jothi Murugan served over 28 years in Government collegiate education, culminating as Principal of Presidency College, Regional Joint Director of Collegiate Education for Chennai Region, and Vice-Chancellor of Thiruvalluvar University, Vellore. Presently serving as Pro-Chancellor (P&D) at VISTAS, he steers institutional expansion, strategic master planning, and national accreditations.

leaders.name: Dr. Arthi Ganesh
leaders.title: Pro-Chancellor (Administration), VISTAS & Academic Advisor, VELS
leaders.quote:
Creating an effective, unique environment for learners at every stage of education is the key to unlocking human excellence and national progress.

Dr. Arthi Ganesh is a multifaceted educationist. As Pro-Chancellor of Vels University and Academic Advisor of Vels Group of Institutions, she oversees the academic functioning of more than 43 institutions offering programs from Pre-KG to Ph.D. for over 42,000 students with 7,500 staff members. Inspired by Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam, Dr. Arthi Ganesh has championed Dr. Kalam’s vision of making India a knowledge superpower through holistic education, student-centric academic culture, and continuous pedagogy innovations.

leaders.name: Prof. Dr. Muthusamy Bhaskaran
leaders.title: Vice-Chancellor (FAC), VISTAS Deemed to be University
leaders.quote:
Higher education and scientific inquiry must directly serve community well-being and industrial progress.

Prof. Dr. Muthusamy Bhaskaran is an eminent scientist, distinguished academic administrator, institution builder, and higher education policy expert with nearly four decades of rich experience in higher education, scientific research, institutional governance, and public policy. His leadership at VISTAS reflects visionary academic standards, administrative innovation, and an unwavering commitment to empowering collegiate research, faculty excellence, and student success.

leaders.name: Dr. M. Chandrasekaran
leaders.title: M.E. (REC), Ph.D. (NIT Trichy) • Registrar, VISTAS

Impeccable governance, statutory transparency, and systematic academic administration form the cornerstone of university credibility.

Prof. Dr. M. Chandrasekaran, a distinguished scholar, eminent administrator, and resourceful torchbearer of academic excellence, stands at the helm of VISTAS as its esteemed Registrar. Grounded in an erudite educational trajectory including a Master of Engineering from REC and a Ph.D. in Production Engineering from NIT Tiruchirappalli, Dr. Chandrasekaran brings over 26 years of experience.

leaders.name: Prof. Dr. A.K. Kathireshan

Preserving examination confidentiality, continuous assessment rigor, and objective academic evaluation safeguards the value of our university credentials worldwide.

overview.subtitle: PCI NEP 2020 Professional Degree Program
overview.title: Future-Ready Pharmaceutical Education
overview.pill: 8 Semesters • Hospital Clinical Training • Research Dissertations
overview.desc_p1: The Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm) program at VEL Pharmacy College is a four-year professional degree meticulously aligned with the Pharmacy Council of India (PCI) NEP 2020 framework. Our curriculum synthesizes foundational pharmaceutical chemistry, pharmaceutics, pharmacognosy, and pharmacology with cutting-edge frontiers including Computer-Aided Drug Design (CADD), Artificial Intelligence in Drug Discovery, and Biostatistics.
overview.desc_p2: Our students undergo direct clinical rotations and bedside patient exposure at the on-campus 300+ bed Vels Medical College Hospital (VMCH), mastering therapeutic drug monitoring, patient counseling, pharmacovigilance, and modern hospital pharmacy logistics.

eligibility.title: Eligibility & Admission Criteria
eligibility.subtitle: As Prescribed by the Pharmacy Council of India (PCI), New Delhi
eligibility.hsc_requirement: Candidates must have passed 10+2 (Higher Secondary) with Physics and Chemistry as compulsory subjects along with either Mathematics or Biology / Botany & Zoology.
eligibility.cutoff_general: Minimum 50% aggregate marks in qualifying examination (40% for reserved categories SC/ST/OBC).
eligibility.lateral_entry: Diploma in Pharmacy (D.Pharm) holders from PCI-approved institutions are eligible for direct admission into the 2nd Year (3rd Semester) of B.Pharm.

career_scope.description: Pharmacy graduates possess unparalleled career flexibility spanning industrial manufacturing, regulatory drug safety, hospital clinical practice, and pharmaceutical entrepreneurship.
roles: Government Drug Inspector & Food Safety Officer
Higher Studies: M.Pharm, MBA Pharma, MS Abroad, Ph.D.

curriculum_overview.title: NEP 2020 Aligned Syllabus Highlights
curriculum_overview.description: 193 Total Credits spread across 8 semesters with modular electives, lab practicals, computer simulations, and 240 hours mandatory industrial / hospital internship.
highlights: Semester 1 & 2: Human Anatomy, Pharmaceutical Analysis, Inorganic Chemistry, Pharmaceutics
Semester 3 & 4: Organic Chemistry, Physical Pharmaceutics, Microbiology, Pharmacology I
Semester 5 & 6: Medicinal Chemistry, Industrial Pharmacy, Pharmacology II & III, Herbal Drug Tech
Semester 7 & 8: Instrumental Methods, Biopharmaceutics, Novel Drug Delivery, Capstone Project

policy.subtitle: Zero Tolerance Campus
policy.title: Our Unwavering Anti-Ragging Stance
policy.quote: At VEL Pharmacy College, we unequivocally reject all forms of ragging as a violation of our core values and a threat to the well-being of our community. Ragging, encompassing any behavior that causes physical or psychological harm to new members, is not only a breach of our code of conduct but also a criminal offense under the Indian Penal Code.
policy.p1: We are committed to fostering a campus culture rooted in respect, dignity, and inclusivity, where every individual can pursue their academic journey free from fear or intimidation. Any instances of ragging will be met with swift and severe disciplinary action, as we stand together to create a safe and supportive environment for all.
policy.p2: In accordance with the Supreme Court of India directives and UGC / PCI regulations, ragging is completely outlawed within the college campus, hostels, college transport, cafeteria, and during off-campus clinical postings.
consequences: Immediate Suspension from attending classes and academic privileges.
Withholding of Results and cancellation of scholarship or financial aid.
Expulsion from Hostels and campus exclusion orders.
Rustication from the university for periods ranging from 1 to 4 semesters.
Filing of Police FIR leading to criminal trial under Indian Penal Code.
